primary_papers.title: Misalignment mechanism for a mass-varying vector boson

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: Mass growth from a scalar field can compensate vector dilution and allow misalignment production of coherent vector abundance.
The model contains a complex scalar charged under dark U(1) and a dark gauge boson with m_X = g_X phi.
The relic X density can become comparable to CDM, but X is not expected to be the whole dark matter.

identity.name: ALP dark matter with photon-dark-photon gauge-field depletion
identity.short_description: An axion-like-particle dark matter setup in which ALP oscillations resonantly source photon and dark-photon gauge fields, depleting the ALP abundance while generating primordial magnetic fields.
identity.historical_origin_or_motivation: Motivated by relaxing ALP overabundance constraints and by extending axion-dark-photon magnetogenesis simulations to earlier times and heavier ALPs.

dark_radiation_species: dark photons sourced during ALP oscillations

self_scattering_channels: classical resonant gauge-field production from ALP oscillations

theory.notes: The paper writes an ALP effective Lagrangian with photon, dark-photon, and mixed axion-gauge topological couplings suppressed by f.

symmetries.stabilizing_mechanism: The ALP is a pseudo Nambu-Goldstone boson of a broken Peccei-Quinn-like symmetry; its cosmological lifetime is assumed long enough for dark matter.

symmetries.name: Peccei-Quinn-like shift symmetry
symmetries.breaking: ALP mass potential V(phi)=m_phi^2 f^2[1-cos(phi/f)]

resonant transfer of ALP energy to photon and dark-photon fields
production.notes: Gauge-field production depletes the ALP abundance; examples approach Omega_DM h^2=0.12 for selected f or initial inhomogeneity values.
